snippet.title: Drawn Tale — Official Announcement Trailer | Horror game  | Indie game
snippet.description:
Drawn Tale is a creepy adventure with hand-drawn graphics in a 3D space. The story tells of the misfortunes of a boy named Mor in a mysterious place that the locals call "Purgatory." The boy will face dangerous monsters, cruel creatures, and his own demons.
Here you will find puzzles, drama, pleasant atmospheric music, an abundance of dark humor, and a fair amount of cruelty contrasting with pleasant hand-drawn visuals.
